problems.title: FizzBuzz
problems.prompt: Print numbers 1..15, but print `Fizz` for multiples of 3, `Buzz` for multiples of 5, and `FizzBuzz` for multiples of both.
hints: Use else-if chains with the modulo operator.
problems.expectedOutput:
1
2
Fizz
4
Buzz
Fizz
7
8
Fizz
Buzz
11
Fizz
13
14
FizzBuzz

problems.title: Reverse a string
problems.prompt: Reverse a string and print the reverse of `hello`.

problems.title: Two Sum
problems.prompt: Given `nums` and a `target`, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to the target. For `{2, 7, 11, 15}` and target `9`, print the indices separated by a space.
hints: Use a HashMap<Integer, Integer> from value to index.
For each element, look up target - nums[i].

problems.title: Palindrome check
problems.prompt: Return whether a string reads the same forwards and backwards. Print the result for `racecar`.
hints: Return false on the first mismatch.

problems.title: Thread-safe LRU sketch
problems.prompt: Implement a minimal LRU cache with get/put, capacity N, using LinkedHashMap access-order. Discuss (in a comment) why ConcurrentHashMap alone is not enough for LRU eviction ordering.
hints: Wrap mutating methods with synchronized or use a ConcurrentHashMap + separate order structure.
problems.expectedOutput: (self-check: get returns most recently used; eldest evicted when over capacity)
